newsitem.title: USA: Softpoint Inc sets reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: Softpoint Inc sets reverse stock split.

text.p: Acquest Corp, formerly Softpoint Inc, said on Monday that it initiated a one-for-10 reverse stock split.
Each shareholder of the company receives one share of common stock for every 10 shares of common stock previously held, a statement from the company said.
The statement said company shareholders will individually receive letters explaining the business reasons for the stock split.
Effective October 21, Softpoint's name was changed to Acquest , and will trade under the symbol AQST.OB, the statement said.
